description: Rewrite or write text so it sounds like a real person, not an AI. Strips the tells (filler openers, "Great question", em-dash chains, rule-of-three lists, "delve", hedging, summary closers). Use when the user says "humanize this", "sound less like AI", "less robotic", "make it natural", or when writing captions, DMs, bios, emails or anything the user will post in their own voice.
